title: Static Broad-Bill Short-Neck Waterfowl
description: One newly authored whole stylised duck-like waterfowl in a fixed grounded pose. A low horizontal boat-shaped torso rises at the front into a short neck and rounded head in one continuous skin; a broad flattened bill has a rounded front outline and full material thickness. Two complete side-folded tapered wings lie along the back, and two short legs meet broad shallow-webbed feet with gently scalloped front margins rather than long separated toes. Small lateral eyes and a short raised tail end complete the whole. No old upright penguin body/flipper, long wading-bird neck/bill or foot outline imported. One static animal prop, zero scenes. No exact species, age, feather anatomy, swimming, flight, gait, rig, buoyancy, biological or ecological function claim.
